content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration paid per session, depending on the qualification and performance of the candidate, as decided by the selection committee. Part-time, temporary engagement on contract basis for 50 sessions per post (Nov. 2026 to Jan. 2027) Duration of one session: 2.30 hours Tenure of engagement may be extended based on the requirement of the Institute Service may be terminated by giving one month's notice

Bring all certificates in original and photocopy in support of qualifications and experience. Bring 2 passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 14 December 2026, and candidates report at 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Table Tennis Coach, 1 Badminton Coach.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 14 December 2026 at 3:00 PM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dean (SW) Office, Student Activity Centre, 1st Floor, National Institute of Technology Patna.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 600-1200 per session for Table Tennis Coach, Rs. 600-1200 per session for Badminton Coach.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Coaching in respective game; OR B.P.Ed with minimum 2 years coaching/teaching experience; OR 12th Pass Certificate with Inter-State / University / National Medallist or International Player status. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid by the institute for conducting the training sessions.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Remuneration per session is decided by the selection committee based on qualification and performance of the candidate.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Part-time, temporary engagement on contract basis for 50 sessions per post (Nov. 2026 to Jan. 2027). Duration of one session: 2.30 hours. Tenure of engagement may be extended based on the requirement of the Institute.
